name: bg-compact
description: Adds server-side context editing (clear_tool_uses_20250919) to every engine Messages request, and pre-computes a summary before the auto-compact limit so the compaction is that summary plus every message after it.

triggerTokens.title: Trigger tokens
triggerTokens.description: Input tokens at which the API starts clearing old tool results. An integer of at least 1.

keepToolUses.title: Kept tool uses
keepToolUses.description: Most recent tool use/result pairs the API keeps whole. An integer of at least 0.

clearAtLeastTokens.title: Clear at least
clearAtLeastTokens.description: Input tokens a clear must free, or the API skips it and the prompt cache stays intact. An integer of at least 0; 0 sends no minimum.

preCompactRatio.title: Pre-compaction ratio
preCompactRatio.description: Fraction of the auto-compact limit at which a turn end forks the first summary. Between 0 and 1.

extendRatio.title: Extend ratio
extendRatio.description: Fraction of the auto-compact limit the tokens after the stored summary may reach before a turn end forks an extended summary. Between 0 and 1.
